findings.finding: The old preregistration target_scope binds exactly UF20_02, UF20_03, UF20_04, and UF20_05 rather than a source-independent manifest rule.

The old preregistration freezes per-source remove_constraints and remove_leaves identifiers for the four inspected sources; the transform consumes that frozen list rather than discovering qualifying pendants by a source-independent predicate.
The Captain review explicitly checks exact_four_sources_bound and authorizes rebuilding and executing the transform only on the four frozen original projected raws.
The candidate implementation hardcodes ORDER=(UF20_02,UF20_03,UF20_04,UF20_05), source paths, source blob bindings, projected-raw SHA256 values, and consumes prereg.frozen_per_source_targets[source].

The independent checker independently reconstructs the same transform but likewise hardcodes the same four-source ORDER/SOURCES map and consumes the same frozen per-source target table. Independence of implementation therefore does not establish genericity to unseen sources.

The frozen result licenses semantics only for UF20_02 through UF20_05 and exactly one frozen simultaneous round, and explicitly lists GENERALIZE_THE_REDUCTION_TO_UNSEEN_OR_ARBITRARY_INSTANCES as not licensed.

requirements: Define every preprocessing target by a source-independent structural predicate rather than source names, clause IDs, leaf IDs, route labels, or observed outcomes.
Bind the already-frozen UF20_016_to_UF20_020 source manifest without reading or computing structural outcomes before the preregistration and its review are frozen.
Specify simultaneous versus iterative behavior before execution; no post-outcome target discovery is permitted unless explicitly preregistered generically.
Specify exact semantic preservation and reconstruction preconditions generically and fail closed when a precondition is absent.
Use an independent checker that receives the same frozen manifest but does not import candidate code or candidate target selections.

Keep WL, sealed portfolio, solver, route classification, automorphism, group, carrier, adapter, quotient, and general SAT claims forbidden during preprocessing preregistration and preprocessing execution.
